_help: enabled: false = mod off, the hub dresses the bots as usual. colors: "player" = each pro's own colours (from their replays), "club" = club colours like the hub. force: one car for a player every match, e.g. {"zen": "r2"} (r1 = their usual car, r2 the next one..., h1 = the hub's first preset for them); {} = normal draw. fallback: players with no replay use a real pro car (always the same one) instead of the hub's default car. looks_per_player: how many of a player's presets are in the draw. fix_hub_finishes: shows the paint finish of the hub's own presets.
